channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Los insultos de Milei a Lula llevan a Argentina y Brasil al peor choque diplomático en años
item.description: Insults by Argentine President Javier Milei toward his Brazilian counterpart Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva triggered the worst diplomatic crisis between the two countries in years, despite personal animosity. Nonetheless, South America's major economies have learned to coexist with such differences, keeping cooperation alive even without harmony in leadership.

item.title: Por dentro das convenções de Flávio, Caiado e Zema - O Assunto #1770
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro was confirmed as the PL's presidential candidate in a convention featuring an AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro, appearances by Michelle Bolsonaro, and endorsements from Javier Milei and Benjamin Netanyahu. Ronaldo Caiado was officially nominated by the PSD as an anti-Lula and anti-Flávio alternative, with Gilberto Kassab as his running mate. Romeu Zema was launched by the Novo party without a vice-presidential candidate, emphasizing an anti-PT stance. The PT has filed a complaint with the TSE over the AI-generated Bolsonaro video.

item.title: Vídeo de IA de Jair Bolsonaro pode ter consequências para o PL e o ex-presidente, avaliam especialistas
item.description: The PL displayed an AI-generated video simulating Jair Bolsonaro at its national convention, claiming he is 'imprisoned and silenced' and urging support for Flávio Bolsonaro as presidential candidate. Experts state the deepfake violates TSE resolution banning synthetic content to replace a living person's image or voice, even with authorization, and that Bolsonaro, under house arrest, is barred from disseminating political-electoral content. The incident may lead to fines or a ban on AI use in campaigns.

item.title: Javier Milei compartilha posts no X criticando Lula
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei shared posts on X criticizing Brazilian President Lula, calling him a 'thief' and accusing him of corruption and money laundering, while also attacking Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. The remarks, made during a PL party event in São Paulo, triggered a diplomatic crisis, prompting Brazil’s foreign ministry to summon ambassadors for consultations and file formal protests. Milei also referenced the so-called 'Lula risk' and highlighted perceived hypocrisy in the PT’s past support for Sergio Massa in 2023 versus his current criticism of Milei’s backing of Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Deputado argentino propõe repúdio a falas de Milei contra Lula
item.description: Argentine deputy Jorge Taiana introduced a declaration project in Argentina’s Chamber of Deputies to condemn President Javier Milei’s insults against Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, labeling them as 'flagrant interference' in Brazil’s internal affairs. The initiative gained support from 30 deputies (12% of the chamber) amid rising diplomatic tensions following Milei’s speech at the PL convention in São Paulo, where he endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro’s candidacy. Argentina’s Foreign Ministry summoned the Brazilian ambassador to Buenos Aires for consultations, signaling strong dissatisfaction without breaking diplomatic ties.

item.title: Zema diz que Milei “falou verdades”, mas errou no tom das críticas
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) said Argentine President Javier Milei spoke truths in criticizing Lula and Alexandre de Moraes, but disagreed with the disrespectful tone used, especially since the remarks were made at a festive PL event. Zema suggested Milei should have used official diplomatic channels, such as the Argentine embassy in Brasília, to express his views. He added that while he agrees with the substance of the criticisms, the inappropriate manner harms political discourse and Brazil-Argentina relations.

item.title: Brasil aciona OMC contra tarifas de Trump e contesta medidas dos EUA
item.description: Brazil has formally requested consultations at the WTO against U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, arguing the measures are unjustified and violate international trade agreements. The 25% and 12.5% tariffs were imposed under Section 301 of the U.S. Trade Act, in response to allegations of unfair practices in digital trade, ethanol access, deforestation, and Pix.

item.title: Entenda como funcionam o fundo eleitoral e o fundo partidário, principais financiadores de campanhas
item.description: In Brazil, electoral campaign financing is predominantly public, with the Special Fund for Financial Assistance to Political Parties (partido fund) and the Special Campaign Financing Fund (FEFC), commonly known as the electoral fund or 'big fund', serving as the main sources. These public mechanisms support parties and candidates in conducting campaigns, reducing reliance on private donations.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio flerta com o risco e testa indicados por seu pai ao STF
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign used a deepfake of former President Jair Bolsonaro, raising concerns about potential violations of electoral rules on artificial intelligence use. According to VEJA's politics editor, José Benedito da Silva, TSE regulations clearly prohibit digitally manipulating real people's images or voices to benefit or harm candidacies, even if labeled as artificial. The move may test the TSE's enforcement and risk revoking Jair Bolsonaro's house arrest if seen-arrest if deemed an attempt to circumvent judicial restrictions.

item.title: Morre Odelmo Leão, ex-prefeito de Uberlândia e ex-deputado federal, aos 80 anos
item.description: Odelmo Leão, former mayor of Uberlândia and five-term federal deputy from Minas Gerais, died at 80 after falling ill. He had announced his bid for re-election to the Chamber of Deputies just seven days prior, citing unfinished work for the state. His passing was mourned by his party, the Progressistas, the Uberlândia City Council, and political figures, who praised his dedication to public service.

item.title: PT aciona Gonet para investigar participação de Milei em evento de Flávio
item.description: The PT, through the Brazil of Hope Federation, filed a complaint with the Electoral General Prosecutor's Office requesting an investigation into Argentine President Javier Milei's participation in the Liberal Party's national convention, where he endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential pre-candidacy and criticized President Lula and STF ministers. The federation argues Milei exceeded institutional boundaries by using his public office to influence Brazilian voters, constituting potential foreign interference in the electoral process.

item.title: TSE firma acordo com a Meta para combater desinformação nas eleições
item.description: The TSE signed an agreement with Meta to combat misinformation in the 2026 elections, establishing reporting channels and enhancing direct communication to reduce the spread of false news across Facebook, Instagram, Threads, and WhatsApp.

item.title: "Temos que virar a página", diz Haddad sobre falas de Milei
item.description: Fernando Haddad, former Finance Minister and São Paulo gubernatorial candidate, said Brazil must 'turn the page' after Argentine President Javier Milei's offensive remarks during his visit, which included criticism of the Lula government, the STF, and Brazilian authorities. Haddad stressed that despite the incident, bilateral relations between Brazil and Argentina will continue due to shared cultural, economic, and social interests, and that cordiality must be restored.

item.title: A estratégia de Flávio Bolsonaro que pode assustar o eleitor
item.description: The hardening of rhetoric between Brazil and Argentina, following Javier Milei's statements against Lula, has triggered diplomatic tension. According to José Benedito da Silva, VEJA's politics editor, Flávio Bolsonaro's strategy of aligning with international right-wing leaders — including Trump and Milei — may have limited electoral impact and could even alienate part of the electorate, which he describes as 'rather misguided'.

item.title: Governo Lula formaliza queixa na OMC contra tarifaço dos EUA
item.description: The Lula government filed a formal complaint at the WTO against U.S. tariffs of 25% and 12,5% imposed under Section 301 of the 1974 Trade Act, arguing they are unjustified and violate international trade agreements. The U.S. measures, based on claims that Brazil favors Pix and uses forced labor in production, are rejected by Brasilia, which asserts it has effective policies against slave-like labor.

item.title: ‘Bancada Zambelli’ terá mãe, irmão e advogado da ex-deputada que fugiu para a Itália como candidatos
item.description: The 2026 election is expected to feature at least three candidates closely tied to Carla Zambelli: her mother Rita Zambelli Salgado, her brother Bruno Zambelli Salgado, and her lawyer Fábio Pagnozzi. Rita and Bruno are listed in the São Paulo PL state convention minutes, with Rita running for federal deputy and Bruno seeking re-election as state deputy. Fábio Pagnozzi, who defended Zambelli in the STF cases leading to her conviction and opposed her extradition from Italy, is running as a Novo party candidate.

item.title: Governo Lula aciona OMC contra tarifaço dos Estados Unidos
item.description: The Lula government has filed a consultation request at the WTO against U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products, deeming them unjustified and incompatible with GATT 1994 rules. The measures include a 25% surcharge on specific goods and an additional 12.5% tied to forced labor allegations, affecting 47.3% of Brazil's exports to the United States.

item.title: PL lança candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro com Jair de IA e Michelle de papelão
item.description: The Liberal Party officially launched Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy for 2026, using an AI-generated avatar of Jair Bolsonaro and a cardboard cutout of Michelle Bolsonaro during the event. The tactic sparked controversy and analysis regarding innovative and symbolic marketing in electoral campaigns, highlighting trends of personalization and technology in Brazilian politics.

item.title: Flávio não perde votos com abandono do Centrão; perde o Centrão com abandono do eleitor independente
item.description: The withdrawal of Centrão allies from Flávio Bolsonaro’s candidacy is more a political signal than an electoral one, as it does not necessarily entail direct vote loss. The real threat to his campaign is the erosion of support in the Southeast, particularly among independent center and center-right voters, whose decisive backing is being undermined by his actions and controversies. The Centrão’s abandonment is a consequence, not the cause, of his declining appeal among the electorate that once propelled Jair Bolsonaro to victory.

item.title: Governo Lula aciona OMC contra tarifaço de Trump, diz Itamaraty
item.description: The Brazilian government has filed a complaint with the World Trade Organization (WTO) against U.S. tariffs on Brazilian exports, arguing the measures violate international trade agreements. The complaint targets two tariffs: a 25% duty based on claims of unfair trade practices and a 12.5% duty linked to alleged failures in preventing forced labor in supply chains. While the move is formal, Brazilian diplomats view it as largely symbolic, intended to signal Brazil’s stance to the United States.

item.title: Trump recorre ao Supremo para alterar voto antes das eleições
item.description: The Trump administration asked the U.S. Supreme Court to halt lower court rulings blocking an executive order that would change mail-in voting rules ahead of the November elections. The order would require the U.S. Postal Service to deliver ballots only to individuals on a newly created 'state citizens list,' a move challenged by Democratic officials in 23 states and D.C. as unconstitutional, asserting that election rules are the domain of states and Congress. The filing followed Trump’s national address defending the changes and questioning election legitimacy.

item.title: Milei lota rede social com críticas a Lula em meio a crise diplomática
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei flooded his X account with criticisms of Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, calling him a 'thief', 'convict', and 'socialist trash'. The posts were made during the launch event of his ally, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, in São Paulo. The incident unfolds amid growing diplomatic tensions between Argentina and Brazil.

item.title: Campanha de Lula lança jingle inspirado no ‘Rap do Silva’, clássico do funk dos anos 90
item.description: The PT's communications team launched an official jingle for Lula's re-election campaign, inspired by the 90s funk classic 'Rap do Silva'. The strategy aims to connect Lula's personal and political trajectory to the identity of an ordinary Brazilian, using popular culture to strengthen electoral empathy.

item.title: Eleições 2026: TSE e Kwai unem esforços contra a desinformação
item.description: The TSE and Kwai signed a memorandum of understanding to combat misinformation in the 2026 elections, including the creation of an internal H5 page with reliable electoral content and periodic meetings to monitor and adjust counter-disinformation measures. The partnership aims to enhance transparency and electoral integrity by promoting quality information on the platform.

item.title: Milei compartilha série de posts com críticas a Lula: 'Nojo de todos os idiotas e hipócritas que pediram desculpas'
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei shared multiple criticisms of Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva on X, calling him an 'ex-convict', hypocrite, and accuser of spreading fake news and supporting the Foro de São Paulo. The posts followed Milei’s appearance at a PL convention that nominated Flávio Bolsonaro, heightening bilateral tensions. Lula avoided direct comment, mocking Milei in a public appearance.

item.title: Não há sucessor natural de Lula, diz diretor do MST
item.description: João Paulo Rodrigues, director of the MST, stated that there is no 'natural successor' to President Lula at this time and that the next leadership of the Brazilian left will be formed through collective struggles, not individual designation.

item.title: Augusto Cury negocia com Aldo Rebelo aliança para outubro
item.description: Augusto Cury, pre-candidate for president from Avante, is negotiating to form a ticket with Aldo Rebelo, former minister linked to the DC (Democracia Cristã), aiming for the October elections. The proposed agreement would have Cury as presidential candidate and Aldo as his running mate. The text notes the deal depends on finalizing candidacies before the legal deadline.

item.title: Milei compartilha série de publicações com críticas a Lula
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei shared five social media posts criticizing Brazilian President Lula within a four-hour window on Monday, the 27th. Some of the posts questioned Lula's role in Argentina's 2023 presidential election. Milei's supporters accuse Lula of interfering in Argentina's domestic politics.

item.title: “O 1º desastre a ser evitado é a perda de vidas”, diz Leite sobre chuvas
item.description: Governor Eduardo Leite (PSD) warned that the primary disaster to avoid in Rio Grande do Sul's July rains is loss of life, noting 425 people are displaced across six municipalities, with Lajeado hosting 268. The state is preparing for three sequential storm events, with risks of hail, strong winds, and flooding across half the territory through August 10, according to Civil Defense.

item.title: Novo projeta eleger até 20 deputados federais e 3 senadores em 2026
item.description: The Novo party aims to elect between 15 and 20 federal deputies and 3 senators in the 2026 elections, seeking to quadruple its current congressional delegation and leverage Romeu Zema’s presidential bid as a national platform. The party is backing candidates such as Ricardo Salles, Deltan Dallagnol, and Marcel van Hattem for the Senate, and plans to strengthen its presence in the Northeast through regional alliances, including support for ACM Neto in Bahia.

item.title: Justiça condena governador do Amapá a multa de R$ 25 mil por propaganda antecipada
item.description: The Electoral Justice of Amapá fined Governor Clécio Luís (União Brasil) R$ 25,000 for premature electoral propaganda, ruling that social media posts linking his personal image to government actions through customized jingles and slogans like 'É Clécio' and 'O Amapá é nossa paixão' constituted an indirect vote request before the official campaign period. The decision mandates the permanent removal of the posts from Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok, bans their republishing or boosting, and imposes a fine of R$ 10,000 per additional violation, capped at R$ 100,000. The governor plans to appeal, arguing there was no explicit vote request and that the posts were merely accountability measures.

item.title: Campanha de Zema terá R$ 5 milhões do fundo eleitoral
item.description: Romeu Zema's (Novo) 2026 presidential campaign will receive approximately R$ 5 million from the electoral fund, representing 13.5% of the R$ 37 million the party is expected to receive. The strategy focuses on increasing Zema's exposure through debates, interviews, and public forums to build national recognition beyond Minas Gerais, while expanding the party's presence in the Northeast via candidacies and regional alliances. The economic plan emphasizes fiscal adjustment, productivity gains, administrative and pension reforms, expanded privatizations, and measures to reduce the 'Brazil Cost'.

item.title: Pesquisa Datafolha mostra o mapa religioso da disputa Lula x Flávio
item.description: The Datafolha poll shows religion as a decisive factor in the 2026 presidential race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. Lula leads among Catholic voters (54% to 37%), while Flávio Bolsonaro leads among evangelical voters (60% to 31%). The survey was conducted in person from July 22–23, 2026, with 2,004 voters across 139 Brazilian municipalities, a margin of error of ±2 percentage points, and registered with the TSE under BR-01166/2026.

item.title: Lula diz que “Guerreiras do K-pop” mostra força da Coreia no Brasil
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva highlighted the growing influence of South Korean culture in Brazil, noting the rise in Korean language students, the global reach of Korean cinema, and mistakenly referencing the animation 'Guerreiras do K-pop' as a two-time Oscar winner. He stressed political alignment between Brazil and South Korea, emphasizing cooperation in education, innovation, security, and artificial intelligence, along with agreements on critical minerals signed during his February 2026 visit. The visit reflects Brazil’s effort to diversify markets amid U.S. tariffs.

item.title: Ministra Cármen Lúcia lançará dois livros em BH nesta sexta (31/7)
item.description: STF Minister Cármen Lúcia will launch two books in Belo Horizonte on Friday, July 31, during the Sempre Um Papo TCE Cultural event. The titles are 'Pela mão do povo: Voto e democracia no Brasil' and 'Princípio Constitucional da Solidariedade', both addressing democracy, citizenship, and social justice in Brazil's constitutional trajectory. The free event will take place at 7 PM in the TCEMG auditorium, with entry on a first-come, first-served basis.

item.title: Como está a disputa Lula x Flávio na região com os maiores colégios eleitorais, segundo pesquisa Datafolha
item.description: In the Southeast, Brazil's largest electoral region, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are in a technical tie according to Datafolha, with 44% and 46% voter intention, respectively. This balanced scenario contrasts with Lula's national lead, as Bolsonaro leads in the South and Central-West/North regions, while Lula maintains a wide advantage in the Northeast. The Southeast emerges as the most competitive battleground in the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Nunes Marques será relator de ação do PT contra Flávio e PL por vídeo de Bolsonaro feito com IA exibido na convenção
item.description: TSE President Justice Kássio Nunes Marques has been appointed rapporteur of a lawsuit filed by the Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PCdoB, PV) against the PL and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for premature electoral campaigning and improper use of AI. The suit challenges an AI-generated video simulating Jair Bolsonaro urging support for his son during the PL’s national convention, arguing it violates 2026 electoral rules despite disclosing its synthetic nature. The federation requests immediate removal of the video, a ban on further dissemination, and potential sanctions.

item.title: Eleições 2026: TSE e Google firmam parceria para ampliar acesso a informações confiáveis
item.description: The TSE and Google Brazil have formed a partnership to combat misinformation and expand access to official information for the 2026 Elections. The initiative includes featuring official apps on Google Play Store, digital protection via Project Shield, and training for electoral justice officials.

item.title: Convite a Milei foi um grande erro de Flávio
item.description: The invitation to Argentine President Javier Milei for Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign launch event was seen as a major strategic misstep, given his inappropriate conduct and disrespect toward Brazilian Minister Alexandre de Moraes and national institutions. Although Milei appeals to segments of the international right, his image is poorly regarded in Brazil, particularly after the World Cup, and there is no strong political foundation between Brazil and Argentina to justify such an alliance in this electoral context.

item.title: Michelle divulga vídeo da campanha de Flávio: "Seguimos firmes"
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro released a video supporting Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign following their public reconciliation. She stated they are 'ready' and 'moving forward' with the slogan 'For God, homeland, family and liberty'. The video was shown at the PL national convention in São Paulo, where Flávio’s wife, Fernanda Bolsonaro, spoke on taxes, security, and entrepreneurship as a dentist and mother.

item.title: O que Michelle Bolsonaro mais quis saber sobre a convenção do PL
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro did not attend the PL convention where Flávio Bolsonaro was launched as a presidential candidate, as she continues to care for former president Jair Bolsonaro under house arrest. She closely followed the repercussions of the video she sent to the event, remaining politically active despite her physical absence. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Zema chama emendas de “seguro-reeleição” e defende redução
item.description: Romeu Zema, presidential candidate from the Novo party, criticized parliamentary amendments as a 're-election insurance' and advocated for their reduction and better oversight. He linked the proposal to congressional renewal, suggesting resources should favor non-incumbent candidates. Zema also commented on topics such as the STF and BRICS in recent interviews.

item.title: Nunes Marques será relator de ação do PT contra vídeo de Bolsonaro com IA em apoio a Flávio
item.description: TSE President Justice Kassio Nunes Marques has been appointed as rapporteur for a PT lawsuit against an AI-generated video showing Jair Bolsonaro endorsing Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy. The PT claims the video constitutes premature electoral propaganda and violates precautionary measures imposed by Justice Alexandre de Moraes, which bar Bolsonaro from campaign activities. The case was assigned to Nunes Marques under the TSE's electoral propaganda case distribution system for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Convenção do PL foi de Jair Bolsonaro, o que expressa a inexistência individual autônoma de Flávio
item.description: The PL national convention was essentially a demonstration of support for Jair Bolsonaro, despite formally launching Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy. Flávio was presented as a candidate solely due to his surname and family lineage, lacking independent political standing, and described as an instrument or 'horse' to facilitate Jair’s return to power in 2027. His political isolation and reliance on the Bolsonaro clan are seen as both a strength (secure electoral base) and a weakness (absence of a distinct political identity).

item.title: Zema afirma que Milei disse ‘verdades’ sobre o Brasil, mas que fala deveria ser ‘mais respeitosa’
item.description: Romeu Zema, presidential candidate for Novo, agreed with Argentine President Javier Milei's criticisms of Brazil, calling them truthful regarding the 'Lula risk,' debt crisis, and the STF, but criticized the tone as inappropriate for a festive event, suggesting Milei should have used official diplomatic channels. Zema also claimed the STF has 'sold' ministers and said Brazil should 'put its tail between its legs' in response to Milei's truths, arguing the government should not retaliate.

item.title: Medioli não aprova apoio do PL a Aro: "Vínculo estreito com Zema"
item.description: Vittório Medioli (PL) criticized the PL's support for Marcelo Aro (PP) in the Minas Gerais gubernatorial race, arguing that Aro has close ties to former governor Romeu Zema (Novo) and Mateus Simões (PSD), which he likened to an improper political 'marriage.' Medioli urged the party to resolve internal divisions before forming alliances and expressed doubt that Senator Cleitinho will decide to run, stating the PL must move forward independently to organize a strong electoral campaign.

item.title: “Quem é esse cara?”, diz Lula sobre Javier Milei
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva mocked Argentine President Javier Milei by responding "Who is this guy?" when asked about Milei’s comments during a meeting with South Korea’s president. Milei had labeled Lula a "Lula risk," called Justice Alexandre de Moraes "bald trash," and denounced socialism, escalating diplomatic tensions. Brazil’s foreign ministry summoned both ambassadors in protest, signaling serious dissatisfaction without breaking diplomatic ties.

item.title: Vieira recebe embaixador do Brasil na Argentina após fala de Milei
item.description: Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira met in Brasília with Brazil's ambassador to Argentina, Júlio Bitelli, following harsh criticisms by Argentine President Javier Milei against the Brazilian government. Milei labeled Lula a 'Lula risk' and Justice Minister Alexandre de Moraes a 'bald trash', prompting Brazil to file a formal protest. Vieira will travel to Lima to represent Lula at the inauguration of Peru's president-elect, Keiko Fujimori.

item.title: A reação de Lula às ofensas proferidas por Javier Milei
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva responded lightly to Argentine President Javier Milei's insults, jokingly asking 'Who is this guy?' when questioned by reporters. Milei, during a visit to Brazil, called Lula a 'convict' and referred to Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes as 'bald trash', while also criticizing Brazil's judiciary and fiscal policy. Despite Lula's casual tone, the Brazilian government recalled its ambassador from Argentina for explanations, and Finance Minister Dário Durigan labeled Milei a 'clown'.

item.title: Versão de Bolsonaro em IA vira desafio para o TSE, enquanto campanha de Flávio adota cautela e cogita boneco de papelão
item.description: The use of AI to replicate Jair Bolsonaro's image and voice at the PL convention sparked legal scrutiny at the TSE, which is assessing whether it violates electoral rules or STF-imposed precautionary measures. Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign has opted for caution, avoiding further AI-generated content until the TSE provides legal clarity, though allies maintain the initial video was compliant and the strategy remains under consideration, including alternatives like cardboard cutouts.
